{"consolidated_memory":"## Flaky CI Pipeline Job in build/ci/pipeline.yml — Two Separate Incidents

**Occasion 1: [2026-02-18]**
- File: build/ci/pipeline.yml (build system)
- Problem: flaky job in CI pipeline
- Repro: rerun same commit ten times
- Signal: one job failing on minority of runs
- Trigger: two requests raced on same key
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #2925 on branch fix/flaky-job-1
- Result: flaky test failures dropped from 82 per hundred runs to zero
- Stack: YAML
- Covering check: pipeline replay job

**Occasion 2: [2026-02-23]** (5 days later)
- File: build/ci/pipeline.yml (build system)
- Problem: flaky job in CI pipeline
- Repro: rerun same commit ten times
- Signal: one job failing on minority of runs
- Trigger: staging read replica
- Root cause: schema drift between migration and model
- Fix: regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum
- PR #5427 on branch fix/flaky-job-2
- Result: memory settled at 359 MB instead of climbing past 8 GB
- Stack: YAML
- Covering check: pipeline replay job

Both incidents manifested as flaky pipeline failures with similar reproduction patterns but entirely different underlying causes and required separate fixes."}
